title: Arthur Miller's birth chart
metaDescription: Arthur Miller's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 23.2° Libra. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: 0.1° separates Venus and Neptune from an exact square; at that range taste and imagination read as one mechanism. Right angles are where the scheme puts its grit. A square asks two functions to work in a mode neither would have chosen.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's position resolves to 23.2° Libra — deep enough in the third decan (20°–30°) that Mercury, its traditional sub-ruler, colours the reading.

blocks.title: Closer to the ground
blocks.text: For the fast movers, Mercury was at 3.7° Scorpio, Venus was at 2.5° Scorpio, Mars was at 5.3° Leo. Read together: thought steeped in tone and memory; attraction that works by atmosphere; effort spent in bursts and openings.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Nothing in the geometry sits closer than Venus and Neptune: 0.1° from an exact square. Right angles are where the scheme puts its grit. A square asks two functions to work in a mode neither would have chosen. Behind it, Mercury trine Pluto at 0.4°, and Venus trine Pluto at 0.8° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. All of it stands whatever the hour was: each angle was tested from midnight to midnight before it was written down.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: The Moon makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Read against the old dignities, four placements stand out. The Sun in Libra at 23.2° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Venus in Scorpio at 2.5° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Jupiter in Pisces at 19.9° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Saturn in Cancer at 16.4° is in detriment. None of this ranks anyone; dignity describes footing, and footing can be worked with.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Balance, counted honestly across the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: elements water 5, air 3, fire 2; modalities fixed 6, cardinal 3, mutable 1. No settled placement falls in earth — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. Mercury, Jupiter, Uranus and Pluto were retrograde — apparent backward motion from where the Earth sits, which the tradition reads as a function turned inward before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Aquarius for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 13.4° between midnight and midnight. That is quick enough to make the exact degree a neighbourhood rather than an address, and slow enough to leave the sign settled. At the noon reference it stands at 20.2°.
